title: Review Logs row
description: One row of the 'Review Logs' tab of the Ancillary Code Reviews sheet. Property names are the sheet's column headers, verbatim and in column order (A to P). A tool that emits a row for pasting writes the values tab-separated in exactly this order.

Reviewer.description: First name of the human reviewer. Two reviewers are written 'A/B'.

Date Reviewed.description: Written as 'Nov 19, 2026'. Older rows in the sheet use other spellings; readers must tolerate them, writers must use this one.

Ticket.description: Jira key, e.g. 'ABC-123'. Several keys are joined with ' / '. 'N/A' when there is none.

PR.description: '#<number> - <title> (<url>)'. The repo (owner/name) is read from the URL.

Recommendation.description: YES when the AI review recommended at least one change.

Accepted Recommendation.description: YES when at least one recommended change was applied (or made moot) before or after merge.

Actual Time (mins).description: Minutes the human reviewer spent. Older rows hold text such as 'No Claude AI review'; readers must treat non-numbers as missing.

Est. Time w/o Claude (min).description: A guess. No gate uses it.

Recommendation Severity.description: Highest severity among the AI findings: 'Important', 'Nit', 'Pre-existing', or '' when there were none. Older rows may hold other words such as 'Minor'.

Findings: Both Found.description: Problems the AI and the human reviewer both found.

Findings: AI Only, Real.description: AI findings the human did not find and agreed were real.

Findings: AI Only, False.description: AI findings judged false (wrong, or noise that REVIEW.md says not to flag).

Findings: Human Only.description: Problems the human found that the AI missed. Each one should become a REVIEW.md rule and an eval case.
